data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 黄昏天台的微风侧颜
data.description: 千年主楼高层天台花园，落日余晖将远方摩天大楼群染成一片壮丽的金红。诺亚迎风伫立在观景栏杆前，白大衣下摆在风中猎猎作响，极长的银白发丝曼妙飞舞。她回首望向老师，落日余晖勾勒出无可挑剔的侧颜轮廓，眼神从容而摄人心魄。
data.action: 她回首望向老师，落日余晖勾勒出无可挑剔的侧颜轮廓，眼神从容而摄人心魄
data.lighting: brilliant golden hour rim light and warm dusk twilight
data.promptProse: Standing along the glass-and-steel observation railing of a high-rise Millennium rooftop garden in her tailored white trench coat and seminar uniform, Noa rests one gloved hand on the bar as the evening wind sweeps her long silver-white hair across the sky. She turns back smoothly toward the viewer with a composed, captivating smile while the wide metropolis stretches out below in crimson and gold. Brilliant golden-hour backlight rims her coat hem, flowing hair, and profile against the glowing twilight skyline.
data.animaCaption: Standing at the high-rise rooftop railing in her white trench coat, Noa turns back with a calm smile as the evening breeze lifts her long hair across the skyline. Radiant golden-hour rim light outlines her profile above the glowing city.
